LESSON: PILLARS OF ISLAM

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Pillars of Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pillars of Islam. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recite the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their ( 5 Lessons)
2. Pronounce the Shahadah as an act of ibadah
3. Appreciate the importance of Shahadah as a basic principle of Islam.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recite the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their ( 5 Lessons)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their ( 5 Lessons). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Pronounce the Shahadah as an act of ibadah
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to pronounce the Shahadah as an act of ibadah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the importance of Shahadah as a basic principle of Islam.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of Shahadah as a basic principle of Islam. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pillars of Islam.
2. Explain Pillars of Islam to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pillars of Islam.
4. Show that you can: Recite the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their ( 5 Lessons)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pillars of Islam. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Pillars of Islam important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Recite the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their ( 5 Lessons)
2. Pronounce the Shahadah as an act of ibadah
3. Appreciate the importance of Shahadah as a basic principle of Islam.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
